item.title: Jennifer Jacob interview with Energeticcity.ca in 2023
item.description: The mother of the Tumbler Ridge shooter spoke out about healthcare shortages in northeast B.C. just over two years before she was one of the first victims of a mass shooting perpetrated by her child. Energeticcity.ca is releasing audio from an interview conducted in November 2023, when Jennifer Jacobs - then named as Jennifer Strang - spoke about her struggles to access care in Tumbler Ridge after one of her other children developed appendicitis. item.title: Vigil for victims of Tumbler Ridge school shooting
item.description: The community of Tumbler Ridge will come together to honour and remember the victims of the February 10th, 2026 shooting starting at 6 p.m. local time. Dignitaries from all over Canada, including Prime Minister Mark Carney, Governor General of Canada Mary Simon, leader of the opposition Pierre Poilievre, Premier David Eby and many others, will be there to participate in the vigil.
